comment: Every Mach-O in VMPane.app, signed inside-out by scripts/sign.sh (never --deep). Paths are relative to the .app and may be globs. optional=true entries may be absent: QEMU parts (Helpers/qemu) and the SPICE client libraries (VMPaneVM.app/Contents/Frameworks) arrive with the QEMU bundle (qemu/scripts/package.sh); `sign.sh --qemu-only` signs that bundle on its own; *.dylib under MacOS/ exist only in Debug builds (Xcode preview support). Xcode's own local signatures are development-only (Xcode adds e.g. application-identifier to the CLI); sign.sh replaces them.
